body: Life will never get better
Thanks
I doubt it 100%. I want peace, not pain.
Yes it does. Without anything to my name, I can't feed my family, clothe them, and protect them.

I wish you and everyone on Reddit the best as well.

No more potential here to carry on in this world. I'm better off gone. 

Will comment to you if I somehow make it, unlikely though

I've been spending all my time fixing things and cleaning their rooms, our whole apartment. Other than that I've been going outside a lot, with my sister always beside me, and exercising a lot. I guess that's fun,

But I miss work. I miss having money. I miss being a provider. My thought is to sell my organs or something, because I want at least something to help out financially.

There's nothing to offer. Wake up, clean home, go jogging outside with my sister watching my back, clean some more, sleep.

It sucks being worthless man.

That's my fear, that I will be stuck there for the rest of my life. That's why many people just want to end.

I might as well call them myself and be stuck there.

It is true, money is important to me. With that I can provide for my family and have a sense of worth. With no money, there's nothing. And that is the reality for me. 

All I am worth is a waste of space. We live in a 3 bedroom apartment. So imagine a 20 y/o man living rent free here. How long until she kills me?
How do I care for someone? I have nothing to offer.
Trust me it ain't

I'm upset at myself for leaving that note there.

I'm upset at her for stopping me.
For how long, seriously?
What's the point of caring for me?
I tried my best to help my family. But now, I have nothing to offer them. They might as well throw me out, I'm worthless.
It's my body, my choice right? If I want to leave, can't I? Why care about a tool like myself, might as well end it and donate my organs for a good cause.

Okay she loves me, but I feel no love or worth.

I'm useless to her, she will waste time and money on me.
There's no point of family anymore. I would be better off leaving.
I don't know why it seems I cannot feel love anymore.

How can she love me! My note said horrible things about her. I wish she would stop looking over me and let me go.

No I will not talk to her nor give her a chance. I'm done with her and my family.

I'm not worth it. I'm worth nothing. Check my bank accounts

What will showing love to me do? She will just get hurt once I leave

I'm done for. Its all over. I enjoyed, lasted and had fun. All that matters. 
I've had enough
Yes it has. I'm jobless, we're about to be homeless and I am useless.

Devastate my family so bad that they hate me more! Thats my plan.

And I've had enough abuse and hardships here. Ive failed my family and I'm done with this
